CargoHelicopter__desc: A flying cargo vehicle. Hauls goods like a truck but travels over cliffs, buildings and water. Thirsty: it burns far more fuel than a truck.
CargoHelicopterT2__desc: A larger flying cargo vehicle. Carries as much as a big truck over any terrain, at double its fuel burn.
CargoHelicopterT2H__desc: Hydrogen-powered Cargo Helicopter II. It has the same cargo capacity and speed without polluted-air exhaust.
CargoHelicopterT3__desc: Heavy-lift sky crane. Matches the largest truck's load and flies straight over the map, but consumes a great deal of fuel.
CargoHelicopterT3H__desc: Hydrogen-powered heavy-lift sky crane with the capacity and speed of Cargo Helicopter III and no polluted-air exhaust.
OpenHeliportT1__desc: Compact helicopter base with twenty parking stands, five equipment columns and two assembly lines.
OpenHeliportT2__desc: Large helicopter base with forty parking stands, ten equipment columns and four assembly lines.
HeliportComplex__desc: DEPRECATED offshore helicopter base from older versions of this mod. It no longer builds or services helicopters. Replace it with an Open Heliport T1 or T2. It is kept only so existing saves load.
HeliportParkingTooltip: An amber arrow marks a stand already reserved by an incoming helicopter. A stand without an arrow and without a parked helicopter is available. Incoming: {2}.
